class.description: The submodels of the exterior model that [MaszynaE3DRailVehicleRenderingServer] animates - pantograph arms, wipers, mirrors, doors, steps, pendulums - and how the low-poly interior is lit, as the vehicle's MMD names them.

Every door of [code]animdoorprefix:[/code], numbered from 1 - odd on the left, even on the right - each with its first submodel below and that one's, which a folding door turns as well; a name the model has not got is empty (DynObj.cpp:592-622, 5721-5760).
One low-poly cab for both ends (jointcabs:).
How bright the low-poly interior glows with the roof light on.
How fast the low-poly interior follows the roof light [s].
The mirrors in the original's order, odd on the left, even on the right.

Every pantograph of the model in the MMD's order: its lower arm, its pair, upper arm, its pair and slider - none for one without a slider. Posed from the pantograph of the same index of the vehicle's [RailVehiclePantographs].
[code]animpendulumprefix:[/code] 1 to 4, swinging about their x by [member pendulum_amplitude] times the cosine of the engine's turn while the MMD declares levers (DynObj.cpp:1121-1125, 5702-5719).
